events.content:
The dashboard now prerenders its heading and section placeholders while the data fetch runs inside a Suspense boundary. I also enabled partial prefetching and updated Next.js to 16.4.5 because the installed 15.5.29 release rejected the app’s partial prerendering configuration.

`npm run build` passes and reports `/` as a partial prerender. I checked the generated HTML and confirmed it contains the dashboard heading and all four section placeholders.

The dashboard values still depend on `api.example.com`, which is a placeholder endpoint and will fail at runtime until replaced.
